• At the site of Tambo Viejo in Peru, archaeologists uncovered dozens of circular stone storage buildings.

items.stem: The student wants to present the aim of Ferrer's study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Ferrer's 2022 study sought to determine what had been stored in the circular stone buildings at Tambo Viejo.
Ferrer's team analyzed chemical residues preserved in the clay floors of the stone buildings at Tambo Viejo.
Researchers had long disagreed about whether the stone buildings at Tambo Viejo held grain or dried meat.

• Some studies suggest that vaccines given in the morning produce stronger antibody responses than those given later in the day.

Ramaswamy concluded that the morning advantage reported in earlier vaccine studies also holds for adults over 65.
Vaccines given in the morning may produce stronger antibody responses than vaccines given later in the day.
